# design-skill-os — frhscopex

**Repo:** https://github.com/frhscopex/design-skill-os · **Install:** `npx skills add frhscopex/design-skill-os` — installs as the folder `design` (frontmatter `name: Design`).
**In the set:** 1 tool — `design` (964 lines).

## What it is

A design operating system synthesised from ten canonical design books: research, typography,
colour theory, composition, branding, logo design, storytelling, web design, creative process,
professional practice.

## The contract

Reference reading, not a pass. Reach for it when a decision needs a principle behind it — a
typographic choice to defend, a composition argument to settle. It writes nothing.

## Engage

- Direct only: `/design-tools:design <question>`.
